title: Dependency Airlock Protocol and Readiness Thresholds
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Cross-team dependencies continue to cause last-minute scope changes and release slippage because there is no standardized, machine-readable readiness signal or unified escalation path. Background: Recent cutovers for Dedicated capacity and Console rollout showed 3 unblock incidents caused by unclear ownership and different readiness criteria between Eng and Design. Goal: Ship an 'Airlock' protocol: a small, opinionated contract and dashboard that gates roadmap handoffs by a numeric readiness score, enforces pre-cutover checks, and wires automatic escalation if thresholds are missed. Deliverables: 1) Readiness scoring schema (code + docs) with inputs from Eng/Design/Security/Infra, 2) Airlock dashboard tile in Console showing per-initiative scores and gating state, 3) Automated escalation rules that create a triage ticket and ping rotation Slack channel when score < threshold, 4) Cutover playbook and simulation script to validate protocol during a non-production canary week.
acceptance_criteria: Readiness schema defined and approved by Eng, Design, and Security (doc link in links)
Airlock dashboard shows readiness for all initiatives in Roadmap Resilience Initiative with per-team breakdown
Automated escalation creates a triage Linear ticket and notifies #roadmap-airlock Slack when score falls below configured threshold
Cutover playbook executed in a simulated canary for one initiative and runbook steps complete without manual overrides
Oncall rota updated and SLO for dependency resolution (TTR) documented
risks: Teams disagree on weighting of readines inputs leading to low trust in score
False positives: score drops trigger unnecessary escalations if inputs not normalized
Tooling work (dashboard + automation) slips and becomes manual, losing adoption
Customers with cross-team SLAs perceive gating as delay rather than safety net
implementation_notes: Start with conservative threshold: readiness_score >= 70 for green gate
Readiness inputs: API contract signoff, perf SLO evidence, design handoff artifact, security checklist pass, infra capacity reservation
Normalize inputs to 0-100 and document weighting in schema doc
Automation: small Lambda that computes score nightly and posts to dashboard; webhook to create Linear ticket when below threshold
Expose per-team toggles so teams can opt-in to stricter gating during high-risk windows
